	Experience working with an INGO
	Experience working on donor-funded projects

	Excellent written and spoken English


Travel:&nbsp;


	Occasionally

	Strong interpersonal skills.

	Experience working in Nigeria
	Experience working with an INGO
	Experience working on donor-funded projects


Required Languages: 


	Excellent written and spoken English


Travel: 


	Occasionally

	Strong interpersonal skills.
	Strong knowledge of data management, analysis, and interpretation.
	Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
	Knowledge of network protocols, security principles, and best practices.
	Ability to prioritize tasks and work under pressure.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
	Attention to detail and accuracy in work.
	Proactive with strong initiative and follow through.

	Establish and improve operating procedures for inbound transport, customs, warehousing, inventory, and emergency or expedited shipments.
	Report logistics health through on-time delivery, customs-clearance lead time, inventory accuracy, landed cost, and partner-service KPIs; bring risks, options, and recommendations to leadership.


What You’ll Bring


	10+ years of progressively responsible logistics, supply chain, transportation, or operations experience; a Bachelor’s Degree is preferred, with equivalent hands-on experience considered.
	Direct experience with international inbound freight, customs clearance, inland transportation, warehouse operations, and inventory controls in Nigeria or a similarly complex environment.
	Experience owning an operating area end to end with limited oversight, including prioritization, tradeoffs, issue anticipation, and delivery through external partners.
	Ability to analyze shipment, inventory, vendor, and cost data and turn findings into clear decisions, action plans, or escalations.
	Experience building SOPs, dashboards, controls, or operating rhythms that improve execution and reliability.
	Commercial judgment and clear communication with carriers, brokers, forwarders, transporters, warehouse providers, senior stakeholders, and government-facing counterparts.
	High integrity, attention to detail, and persistence in a regulated, ambiguous environment; fluent English and able to work from Lagos with domestic Nigeria and occasional overseas travel.
